assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one high-quality square 3×3 transparent atlas for a Chinese first-grade material-classification game. Exactly nine separate illustrations, one fully isolated and centered per equal invisible grid cell in the exact row-column positions below. Uniform clear alpha between assets, leave at least 13% clear margin on every side of each cell, no border or card behind them. Use warm fine paper grain, matte gouache, simple clean cut-paper silhouettes, subtle texture, rich honey oak, a little pine green and warm cream. Keep material cues bold and readable for small screens, natural edges, and the original designed colors. No text, numbers, symbols, outlines between cells, branding, base ground, glow, or harsh cast shadows.
Row 1 column 1: one shallow rectangular classroom tray with smooth rounded corners, honey-brown natural wood, large clearly visible flowing grain on interior base and a little end grain on the near face. Three-quarter above view, broad rim, no feet.
Row 1 column 2: same shallow rounded rectangular classroom tray shape, same scale, honey-brown color and same three-quarter above view as row 1 column 1, made of molded plastic. Show smooth evenly colored clean walls, rounded molded lip, a subtle shiny highlight and molded seam. Zero wood grain; no wood effect finish. Equal exterior dimensions to the wood tray.
Row 1 column 3: one open pale honey square wooden organizer box with visible broad grain and end grain on the safe rounded walls. No contents, hinges or metal fasteners.
Row 2 column 1: one empty rectangular light honey oak picture frame, a thick frame with a completely transparent open center. No glass, backing or photo. Bold grain and recognizable gently rounded outer edges.
Row 2 column 2: one softly wrinkled blue woven-cloth drawstring pouch with cloth strings, loose natural folds, no metal or plastic parts. Clearly fabric.
Row 2 column 3: one folded, completely blank, thick ivory card, crisp thin-edged paper fold and visible overlapping corner. No words and no extra object.
Row 3 column 1: one thick clear glass shallow fluted dish, see-through center, pale green translucent edge with narrow bright gleam, no liquid or opaque underlay.
Row 3 column 2: one silver tabletop dome bell, silver dome, silver button, low all-metal silver base. Bright but restrained metallic gleam, completely visible. No wood or plastic.
Row 3 column 3: one low mottled gray stone paving tile, strongly visible gray speckled grains, shallow irregular bevel, matte face distinct from metal. All subjects are isolated materials and objects for an original lesson, no logos or page-layout facsimiles.
